summary: The poppet that opens and closes a port to admit the charge or release the exhaust, held closed by a spring and opened either by suction or by a drive train.

variants.name: Separate-head poppet in an open four-window cage
variants.applies_to: Four-cylinder engine with automatic inlet and rocker-operated exhaust valves (Wright 1903)
distinguishing_features: cast-iron head and separate steel stem
open cage with four windows and a guide bore
cage clamped by a ring nut

evidence.locator: four reviewed valve-box circles on the Smithsonian scan; scale uncertainty inherited

dimensions.name: seat angle
dimensions.basis: Feature label "Estimated 45-degree seating face" in part-spec.json.

dimensions.name: spring wire diameter
dimensions.basis: Teaching dimension in part-spec.json (spring_wire); no spring rate is claimed.

construction.note: Cage body with a seat land and a conical seat
Four-legged cage windows and a guide bore

function.role: Admit the charge (inlet) or release the exhaust (exhaust) through a port in the valve box.
function.motion: Inlet valves are automatic: suction opens them against their springs with no positive drive. Exhaust valves are opened by rockers from the camshaft. Lift is 7.9375 mm.

interfaces.name: cage
interfaces.mates_with: valve box, clamped by a ring nut

envelope.statement: Inlet valves open from suction against their springs with no positive drive.

evidence.locator: per research.md "Gas path", summarised in operating-motion.md

envelope.statement: Lift of 7.9375 mm falls inside the exhaust stroke in the baked clip.
envelope.basis: Rung 6 test (scripts/test_wright_reconstruction.mjs); the cam law itself is illustrative.

intent.statement: Open windows pass gas round the seat while the cage guides the stem.
intent.basis: Read from the cage construction in inventory S05; no source in the study states the reason.

manufacturing.material: cast-iron heads and cages, steel stems and springs
manufacturing.process: separate cast head and cage with a separate stem

instances.validation: Interference audit of the exported file is clean: 1,121 neighbouring pairs at rest, 133 poses of the baked clip, 0 overlaps (interference-audit.json); geometry is valid but historical accuracy is not verified (cad-validation.json).

gaps: Cam law and phases are unverified: the lobes are static placeholders and the running motion is illustrative (inventory gaps).
Spring properties are unknown, so no spring rate is claimed.
Thread helices on the ring nuts are omitted.

variants.name: One-piece revolved poppet: automatic inlet, punch-rod exhaust
variants.applies_to: Five-cylinder radial with one inlet and one exhaust valve per cylinder (Langley / Manly-Balzer)
distinguishing_features: inlet and exhaust valves each one profile of revolution (head and stem)
inlet seat is a separate cast-iron piece held by a nut in the head
exhaust stem passes through a long coil spring and ends 1/64 in above the punch rod
valve axis offset toward the port drum

dimensions.name: valve axis offset from the cylinder axis
exhaust lift
dimensions.basis: Not documented (part-spec.json cam_rise rationale); the cam rise is the lift plus the documented gap.

construction.note: Valve head and stem as one derived profile of revolution (the inlet and exhaust differ in stem diameter and length)

function.role: Admit mixture on suction (inlet, no drive) and release exhaust when struck through the punch rod (exhaust).
function.motion: Inlet opens by suction against its spring. Exhaust is lifted by the punch rod from the ring cam, then closed by its spring.

interfaces.name: inlet head
interfaces.mates_with: inlet seat (cast iron, held by a nut)

envelope.statement: At rest the exhaust stem ends 1/64 in above the punch rod.
Each exhaust valve is open for about 224 crank degrees.
envelope.basis: Follows from the illustrative cam lobe half width of 28 cam degrees at a quarter of crank speed (part-spec.json).

intent.statement: An automatic inlet needs no drive train, so one cam and five punch rods serve the whole engine.
intent.basis: The arrangement is documented (M1 pp. 237, 240; A1 p. 186); its purpose is not stated.

manufacturing.basis: The study records steel for the valve parts (part-spec.json); it cites no statement of valve material or process.

instances.validation: Interference audit of the exported file is clean: 1,492 neighbouring pairs at rest, 133 poses of the baked clip, 0 overlaps (interference-audit.json); mass check against the Memoir weight table in build-notes.md.

gaps: Lift and lobe form are illustrative.
Seats, springs, caps and guides are separate parts in the study (L17, L18) and are not described on this card.
